# Time to next treatment line

**Status: blocked — line-transition definition not ready.**

The future treatment-line schema must provide `id`, unique `treatment_id`,
`treatment_line`, `treatment_name`, `start_date`, `stop_date`, a controlled
`line_transition_reason`, `progression_date`, `death_date`,
`follow_up_end_date`, and an observation-completeness flag.  It must specify
whether a same-line regimen change counts as a new line and how maintenance
therapy is classified.

The current `treatment_lines` schema has line numbers and start/stop dates but
not the approved transition reason or completeness/censoring fields.  A line
number alone cannot establish time to the *next* line, so no event indicator or
model is produced.
